solution.excerpt:
# RCA: AEME-6535
Update SC+ Automated Report
Generated: 2026-09-03T00:00:00Z

Hi Talib ,

Thank you for reaching out. This ticket requests adding new columns to the existing SC+ automated daily report for UAE PROD.

The SC+ daily report is generated by a Groovy script stored in the Hybris database, not in the compiled codebase. The script is registered as gcc-PROD-Daily-SC-ReportScript (currently version 44, active) and is executed via the ScriptCronJob gcc-Report-NonPII-Email-PRODDailySCReportCronJob, which is backed by the ScriptingJob gcc-PRODDailySCReportScriptingJob. The script carries the ITGC reference PC-29527(Global).

The script queries the ExternalService table for entries where the provider is SMC or STANDALONE_SMC, filtering by order codes starting with AE, KW, OM, or BH, and pulling orders from the last 60 days. It excludes TEMPORARY, TEMPORARY_EXPIRED, and TEMPORARY_REJECTED order statuses. For each ExternalService entry, the script populates an Excel row with 20 columns (indexes 0-19):

0. Store
1. Order ID
2. Order Status
3. Order Creation Date
4. Main Product
5. Main Product Name
6. Require Additional info (Base SKU)
7. SMC Service SKU
8. SMC Service Name
9. Product ID
10. Price (in Local Currency)
11. Currency
12. Price in USD
13. SC+ Policy ID
14. Pre-Registration Status
15. DO (Delivery Order number)
16. Activation Status
17. Activation Date
18. ERP Financial Number
19. Sale Type (Bundle/Standalone)

The script also creates a second sheet called externalServiceMissingOrders that lists standalone SMC orders (product code starting with SMC-AE-STANDALONE) where no ExternalService entry was found, which helps identify orders where SC+ registration was not triggered.

The report is exported as a password-protected xlsx file and emailed to a distribution list including Firas, Anna, Francis, Dilip, Amr, Vishal, Jaffar, Talib, and Yashwant.

To add the requested columns, I will need to modify the Groovy script to include the new column headers and populate them with the appropriate data from the ExternalService, Order, Consignment, or ConsignmentEntry models. Please share the Excel file showing which columns need to be added so I can implement the changes.

Thanks,
Aryan
